card.name: End of noun phrases in warnings
card.fires_on: The last word of a short noun phrase, or a comma right after it, in warning or precautions text about managing patients. The next word is often a preposition, a connector such as 'as' or 'when', or the start of a new clause.

modes.label: Noun ending a phrase
modes.description: Final word of a clinical phrase such as risk-benefit profile, continued treatment, or adverse reactions.
modes.example: Take into account the overall risk-benefit<< profile>> when using MOVANTIK in such patients

modes.label: Comma after a clause
modes.description: A comma that closes a clinical statement before a qualifier like 'in patients whose' or 'as these'.
